title: Force application to use SOCKS proxy with proxychains-ng
summary: Use proxychains-ng to force applications that do not support SOCKS proxies to route their traffic through a configured SOCKS server.
prerequisites: A running SOCKS proxy (e.g., via SSH or local service).

steps.explain: Edit /etc/proxychains.conf and set the last line to your SOCKS proxy, e.g., 'socks5 127.0.0.1 8080'.
Run your desired program prefixed with proxychains. Replace <PROGRAM> with the command you want to run.

placeholders.name: PROGRAM
placeholders.description: The program or command to run through the proxy.
